role.name: Self test - DVA token
role.description: Not a conformance test. Checks that the asserts of the Auth DVA set fire: that they pass on a conforming envelope, that they react to a token that is only signed, to a request without a token, and to a url that carries the patient. Run it with Automated on: the engine then sends the requests itself and no caller is needed. All four scenarios have to end green, the last three on the judgement that the expected warnings appeared.
